A destroyed beacon is replaced on the club.

/obj/item/house_edge.name: House Edge

/obj/item/house_edge.reason: 22 force wielded. Hits build charges that fling you up to 6 tiles, so it closes distance other melee cannot. Damage is ordinary.

/obj/item/katana.name: katana

/obj/item/knife/bloodletter.name: bloodletter

/obj/item/knife/butcher.name: butcher's cleaver

/obj/item/knife/hunting.name: hunting knife

/obj/item/knife/kitchen.name: kitchen knife

/obj/item/knife/kitchen/letter_opener.name: letter opener

/obj/item/knife/ritual.name: ritual knife

/obj/item/lava_staff.name: staff of lava

/obj/item/lead_pipe.name: lead pipe

method: Judged by hand on what it does next to a man in a plain vest: seconds to drop him up close, set against the gun anchors with no credit for range. A block only counts for much if it stops bullets, because it then earns the off hand beside a gun. Authored uniques and boss drops stay off shelves.
